channel.description: Latest articles from The Lawrence Times (lawrencekstimes.com)

item.title: Lawrence City Commission to consider plan for 200-unit complex in Alvamar neighborhood
item.description: City commissioners on Tuesday will consider plans for a 200-unit apartment complex in west Lawrence's Alvamar neighborhood that another city board already voted against. Continue reading ...

item.title: CoreCivic changes course and will ask Leavenworth for permit to house ICE detainees
item.description: Private prison company CoreCivic has applied for a permit to hold immigration detainees at its dormant Leavenworth facility, the city said on Monday. Continue reading ...

item.title: Lawrence school district reports student entries and exits in 2024-25, class sizes
item.description: The Lawrence school district reported that it gained more new students than it lost in 2024-25 from other countries, private schools and other public schools in Kansas, but it lost more students than it gained to public schools outside of Kansas and homeschooling. Continue reading ...

item.title: Lawrence school district to add preschool classrooms at two more neighborhood schools
item.description: Classrooms for 3- and 4-year-olds will open at two Lawrence neighborhood schools in fall 2026, increasing preschool availability in the district to six buildings. Continue reading ...

item.title: Lawrence community events to celebrate Hanukkah
item.description: Upcoming local celebrations of the Jewish festival of Hanukkah will welcome all ages of the public. Continue reading ...

item.title: Lawrence city commissioners approve high-density zoning in Oread neighborhood
item.description: Lawrence city commissioners have approved a request to rezone property near KU's campus for developers to build the densest housing allowed in the city. Continue reading ...

item.title: Lawrence City Commission rejects Alvamar apartment complex plan
item.description: The Lawrence City Commission on Tuesday voted 4-1 to reject a preliminary plan for a 200-unit apartment complex in west Lawrence's Alvamar neighborhood. Continue reading ...

item.title: Lawrence City Commission approves changes to Jayhawk watershed budget; 9th Street to close through summer
item.description: Lawrence City Commissioners on Tuesday approved a $4.82M increase to the budget and change in construction plans that will lead to a portion of Ninth Street being closed through the summer. Continue reading ...
